items.item: The page header has a plural title and at most one primary action; other actions such as export sit in a secondary position
items.evidence: h1 'Thiết bị' (plural-type noun for the collection). Header buttons: 'Xuất CSV' and 'Nhập từ CSV' are outlined/secondary; only #btnAdd 'Thêm thiết bị' is filled bg-blue-700. Audit headerPrimaryActions=1.

items.item: The table appears in the first viewport, with search and 2–3 visible filters (such as location and status) and no row of KPI cards above it
items.evidence: Screenshot shows table rows starting at y~270. Visible: search #q, select #area (Khu vực), select #status (Trạng thái), plus a 'Bộ lọc khác' popover. Only a one-line summary and tabs above the table, no KPI cards. Audit firstTableTop=269.

items.item: By default the list is ordered with overdue inspections first, then inspections due soon, then the rest
items.evidence: DEFAULT.sort='urgency'; sorted() orders by group(e) (0 overdue, 1 <=30 days, 2 rest), then by next date. Screenshot: 9 'Quá hạn' rows first, then 'Còn 2 ngày'... then 'Còn 26 ngày'.

items.item: Overdue and due-soon inspections are marked with a text label (such as "Overdue" or "Due in 7 days"), not by colour alone
items.evidence: inspBadge(): 'Quá hạn N ngày' (red pill), 'Còn N ngày' / 'Đến hạn hôm nay' (amber pill); the text carries the meaning.

items.item: Dates are absolute and consistently formatted, and every row has a human-readable equipment code
items.evidence: Intl.DateTimeFormat vi-VN dd/MM/yyyy used for both last and next dates (e.g. 29/09/2026), relative text only as a supplement. Codes like RB-163, CT-303, NH-436 in a 'Mã thiết bị' column.

items.item: Status tabs or a summary line show counts (such as "Overdue 4")
items.evidence: renderTabs(): 'Tất cả 52', 'Kiểm định quá hạn 9', 'Sắp đến hạn (30 ngày) 7', 'Đang lỗi / bảo trì 14'; plus #summary '52 thiết bị · 9 quá hạn kiểm định · 5 đang lỗi'.

items.item: Rows are single-line, and row actions show at most two visible controls, with icon-only controls having accessible names
items.evidence: Audit rows: single=15, double=0, multi=0, all 40px (whitespace-nowrap cells). Row actions: text button 'Ghi bảo dưỡng' + '⋯' button with aria-label 'Thao tác khác cho thiết bị {code}' (others in a menu). Caveat: the '⋯' button is partly clipped at the right edge in the 1440 screenshot.

items.item: A filter combination with no matches shows a no-results state with a clear-filters action, distinct from the first-use empty state; a loading state and an error state with retry are present
items.evidence: !total branch: 'Không có thiết bị nào khớp…' with #clearAll2 'Xóa bộ lọc'; !data.length branch: 'Chưa có thiết bị nào' with 'Thêm thiết bị' (?state=empty); loading renders .skel skeleton rows with aria-busy; errored branch: 'Không tải được danh sách thiết bị' with #retry 'Thử lại' (?state=error).

items.item: Interactive targets are at least 24×24px, and text and status contrast meets 4.5:1
items.evidence: Audit smallTargets=0 over 93 targets, contrast checked=195 with no violations. Buttons h-8 (32px), chip close 24x24. Native checkboxes are h-4 w-4 (16px) but sit in 40px rows with ample spacing, which the audit accepts. Status pills use *-50 backgrounds with *-700/800 text, slate-600 or darker for secondary text.

notes: Clean, plain-Tailwind admin list: white sidebar with a light-blue active item, single blue accent, no gradients, shadows on cards, avatars, KPI tiles, emoji, uppercase labels or decorative charts. Status pills use a restrained palette (green/blue/red/grey) with text labels, so they are not a rainbow. Minor flaws: 'Mã thiết bị' header wraps to 3 lines in the first viewport, and the row '⋯' button is clipped at the right edge at 1440px (min-w-[1080px] table plus 224px sidebar). A 'Gọn' compact toggle and a 'Nhập từ CSV' secondary button are present. Audit score 100.
